paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18 as of 2026-08-17, representing a decrease of 3.38% from the prior close and an increase of 2.21% over the last 22 trading sessions. There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

This news has been reported by seekingalpha.com and Seeking Alpha on MSN, both on 2026-08-17.

There have been various SEC filings by Fermi Inc., including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary. Additionally, there have been 7 new social posts in the last 24 hours, including a call with Fermi IR and a quote from Jensen Huang regarding the next critical resource for AI factories.
